headline.caveat: 'more than $100M' multi-year for model access; some coverage characterizes the figure as annual — structure undisclosed

nature_md: Announced Nov 18, 2025, a two-directional deal: Intuit pays OpenAI >$100M for model access to power agentic experiences inside its own products, while TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp become apps inside ChatGPT — users can estimate refunds, review credit options, and manage business finances in-chat, with financial data staying inside Intuit's systems and shared only with explicit permission. Part of OpenAI's late-2025 wave of app-platform deals (PayPal, Walmart, Spotify). Money flows Intuit→OpenAI; distribution value flows both ways, and neither side has disclosed any revenue-share on ChatGPT-originated transactions.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Model-access fees as operating expense/cost of revenue within Intuit's AI platform (GenOS) spend; Intuit monetizes downstream through its own product pricing, not per-token resale.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: For OpenAI: committed app-layer enterprise revenue plus a marquee tenant for the ChatGPT apps platform — evidence for the platform thesis underlying its consumer valuation; economically small next to its infrastructure obligations.
